form:FormGroup.label: Keys
form:FormGroup.helpText: Press the keys of the shortcut, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+S, or two keys one after the other without modifiers, e.g. G then U. Press the keys again to start over. Enter accepts the shortcut, Escape cancels and Tab moves on. Some keys, such as Ctrl+W, are kept by the browser and can't be used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Press the keys of the shortcut, then Enter to accept or Escape to cancel.
